Reasoning: This release stage keeps the end-effector fixed while opening the gripper. `freeze_position` enforces no commanded translation of `panda_fingertip`; `freeze_orientation` enforces no commanded rotation. `open_gripper` represents symmetric opening to the open release state. The current top drawer open state and current handle pose are preserved implicitly by commanding no end-effector motion during release, but object/drawer immobility cannot be separately encoded because only one position operator is allowed and the stage specifically requires freezing the fingertip. Finger effort dropping to free-space baseline, unexpected increase in contact effort during opening, failure of fingers to open, and detectable drawer slip/motion are not directly representable with the available operators/condition labels; success is represented by the gripper-opened condition together with fixed fingertip pose.

0.tolerance_m: MPC precision cap; secured-result tool release guard

1.tolerance_rad: MPC angular default; release/retract angular tolerance
